# Flow 4: the Captain says no.
#
# A real integration asks before it runs a command. When the Captain denies it, the command does
# not run, the integration is not punished for asking, and nothing is recorded as if it had worked.

step set up: the vessel and a project that uses git
exec orbiter --output json vessel init -y
exec orbiter --output json galaxy add acme
exec orbiter --output json planet add api --galaxy acme
exec orbiter --output json resource add git --role tool --brand git
exec orbiter --output json attach git api

step calibrate with the client denying every prompt
client -deny -- calibrate api
stdout '"message":"git wants to run: git --version"'
! stdout 'Always allow'

step nothing ran, so nothing was learned: git is still waiting to be found
stdout '"status":"needs_discovery"'
exec orbiter --output json survey api -v
! stdout '"binaries"'

step the integration was not quarantined for being refused
exec orbiter --output json vessel inspect git
stdout '"quarantined":false'
